description.text: Program Description This program aimed to train students to master knowledge of software engineering andthe development of advanced technology. All courses taught in English, without chinese language proficiency requirment. The college is equipped a provinvial key labs in Liaoning Province, computer network intelligent expermental center. Teaching Objective The major is aimed to train students to master thebasic theoretical knowledge of software engineering andthe development of advanced technology,with software developmentand management ability, who can be engaged in thesoftware system analysis,design, development and project management. Future Career Graduates can be software engineers to engage in thesoftware system analysis,design, development and project management. Diploma and Awarded Bachelor of Engineering degree

duration.text: The Software Engineering at Bohai University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 200 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1805 USD/per year ￥ 13000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included 2. Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant 3. High school academic transcript 4. High school graduate certificate Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. 5. Sponsorship letter 6. Resume Written in Chinese or in English 7. Blank Visa Page in Your Passport If you've never been to other countries, please submit the blank page for visa in your passport.

requirements.text: 1. Non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport 2. High school graduate or equivalent to a Chinese high school graduate 3. Be in good health condition and above the age of 18 4. Observe the law and regulations of People's Republic of China and all regulations of the university
